notes: From turn 5 on the Runner clicked for credits up to 31 with a full grip and never installed breakers. It never contested Server 3 while the Corp advanced three agendas there over several turns.
Solid HQ pressure with Utae and a good remote steal through three ice to win. Minor oddities: Steelskin overdraw forced discards, and one turn was spent clicking for credits.

Ran R&D four times a turn, which only re-accessed the same top card, then clicked for credits for ten turns up to 40 with a full grip. Let the Corp advance agendas behind a single Akhet repeatedly without running.

Reasonable R&D/HQ pressure with Red Team and Carmen, but facechecked a three-ice remote with no breakers and overdrew several times. Never found an answer to Hagen, so the Corp's remote agendas went uncontested.
Slow start and several early facechecks that cost cards to net damage, plus repeated Debbie runs into N-Pot it could not pay for. Later stole remote agendas competently through Doomscroll to win.

Kept running through Vertigo/Ansel 1.0 even though they stopped it from stealing, so it accessed agendas it could not take, ran the same server twice in a turn, and lost Carmen twice. There was no coherent plan for breaking ice.

A simple R&D-every-turn plan through a lone Paywall won, but the economy hovered at 0-4 credits and most clicks were spent clicking for 1 credit. Self-modifying Code fetched Gauss that was never used, and the Runner held a full grip of unplayed cards.

Ran R&D four times a turn seeing the same top card, then clicked for credits for ten turns up to 56 with no installs. Let the Corp score three Transport Monopolies from a single-ice remote uncontested.

Repeated HQ/R&D runs that re-accessed the same card, never trashed Bladderwort, and ran into Anemone while holding a small grip against Personal Evolution. Ended a turn with one card in the grip and was flatlined.
Efficient HQ/R&D pressure through Semak-samun, and a clever Chastushka sabotage set up the winning steal. Some idle credit clicks and one facecheck into Knowledge Seeker.
Good use of Tao swaps and Gauss to steal remote agendas. It took a risky facecheck into Tsarevna and carried tags against NBN for long stretches.

Won through steady HQ/R&D pressure, but spent many clicks removing the Trickster Taka tags every turn and could not contest the early Akhet remote. A second R&D run into unrezzed ice lost Stargate and Maemi to Hammer.

Ran into Funhouse repeatedly while broke, piling up tags, then spent the second half of the game removing one tag a turn at 0-2 credits. It never contested the Server 5 agendas and did not trash Federal Fundraising.
Clicked for credits for many turns up to 57 with a full grip and no breakers installed. It left a naked-ish remote agenda and several later remote agendas uncontested.

Early HQ steals were good, but it facechecked unrezzed HQ ice against Jinteki and chose to continue through Karuna's second net-damage sub. That left one card in the grip, and the forced Fujii steal flatlined it.
Ran into Ansel 1.0 up to four times a turn even though it stopped every steal, and lost Marjanah, Cat's Cradle, Carmen and Pennyshaver to it. It made no attempt to build a rig that could break it.
Good use of Gachapon to find Banner, then steady HQ/R&D pressure through Akhet to win. Early facechecks into barriers without a working breaker wasted a few clicks.
After bouncing off Tatu-Bola once, it clicked for credits for five straight turns up to 33 with a full grip. It let the Corp advance and score three agendas in the same remote uncontested.

Trashed campaigns sensibly but kept running into the known Eli 1.0 and Ablative Barrier without breakers, and ended with 34 unused credits. It overdrew into discards and never found a way into the heavily iced remote.

Spent turn 1 installing two Living Murals, then clicked for credits for many turns with a full grip. It skipped the Server 4 agendas (Cryptocrash, Remastered Edition) that it had already shown it could get into.
